_comment: A HYBRID pip must be payable with EITHER of its colours. Boros Reckoner is {R/W}{R/W}{R/W} and
this board is four Plains: no red anywhere, so every pip has to take its SECOND colour. It could
not, and the same held for Slippery Bogle ({G/U}) off Islands and Deathrite Shaman ({B/G}) off a
green-only board -- so this was never EldraziDisplacerFlicker-specific, it hit Auras, Minotaur
and FiveColour, which all ship a hybrid card.
CAUSE: Card.h bakes each hybrid pip into its FIRST colour's flat int and records the pair so
payment can move it (ManaCost::ExpandHybrids). Both plan enumerators summed a subset's cost
field-by-field over the seven flat ints, silently dropping that metadata -- so the summed cost
was fully BAKED and `pool.CanPay(combined)` demanded red. Every downstream site was already
correct (SubsetPayable un-bakes, TapForCostShared expands every assignment, PayFromPool picks a
payable one, TapFlowInfeasible bails on hybrids), which is why the bug survived: the ONE site
that lost the information sat upstream of all of them. AddCostCarryingHybrids already existed
for exactly this reason at two other call sites; the enumerators now use it too.
WHY IT HID FOR SO LONG, and it is worth stating because it defeats the obvious test: a
MULTI-COLOUR source credits `pool.wild`, and CanPayFlat lets wild pay any pip. One untapped dual
or painland therefore MASKS the baked demand and the subset survives. Every affected deck plays
duals, and in each of them the pip's first colour is also the deck's main colour -- so the bug
only bites on a mono-source board that lacks the first colour. It was isolated by sweeping the
library FILLER (Forest/Island fillers rejected the cast that an Adarkar Wastes filler allowed),
not by sweeping colours.
Stakes make the cast MANDATORY rather than merely available: the 3/3 must connect twice for
exactly lethal, so 'the search declined' cannot be confused with 'the search could not'.
Verified DISCRIMINATING: on four Mountains (the FIRST colour) this always passed, before and
after -- it is only the second-colour payment that was broken.
